description: Use to get or nudge the project's working thread: a compact, always-current snapshot (objective, in-progress work, last decisions, open loops, next step, what's in play) assembled live from Wyrm's signals. action=get assembles, persists, and renders it. action=nudge merges an advisory note first: a plain note seeds in-progress (only if no session signal covers it), a note prefixed 'loop:' appends one open loop. A nudge never replaces the signal-derived open loops, decisions, or in-play.
name: wyrm_thread
